long_biography.plain_text:
King began in business-machine sales, rising from trainee to national sales director and helping introduce early computer systems to commercial-property brokers. Those relationships led him toward apartments. While managing a San Jose branch, he bought his first building in Los Gatos, then acquired more after returning to Long Beach.

When his employer proposed another transfer, King chose independent ownership and launched RK Properties in 1976. The company developed a model combining acquisition, financing, leasing and property management, with its own staff operating apartment communities across multiple states. King also brought outside investors into limited partnerships and later tax-deferred investment structures, building a durable national platform focused exclusively on multifamily real estate.
